svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Forge seam architecture
svg.desc: The CLI commands call through the provider-neutral Forge trait. The GitHub adapter implements it by driving gh, while FakeForge provides an in-memory double for tests. Pure modules hold the payload and parsing logic.

g.text: CLI COMMANDS · OSF BINARY ENTRY POINTS
FORGE CORE · PROVIDER-NEUTRAL INTERFACE AND ORC…
PURE LOGIC · NO PROCESS OR NETWORK CALLS
